day_local: Sabtida Toddobaadka Lix iyo Labaatanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaah, iyo wadaagga Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jireen.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
homily:
Waxaa jira subaxyo marka aad kaceyso oo aad dareemeyso in hawadu ay tahay mid qabow oo qoto dheer, adigoo fiirinaya booska uu Benjamin Vo mar walba fadhiisan jiray, adigoo xusuusanaya tallaabadii ugu dambeysay ee wiilkaaga. Maanta, adigoo jooga meeshan, waxaan eegaynaa qolka uu Benjamin ku qaatay saacadihiisa aamusnaanta, halkaas oo ay ku yaalliin buugaagtiisa teknoolojiyadda, kombuyuutarradiisa, iyo sawirrada diyaaradaha uu sida aadka ah u jeclaa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aan kaliya akhriyin buugaagta, laakiin dhisayey fikirkiisa ku saabsan nolosha. Halkaas ayaynu ka billaabaynaa maanta, annagoo aan degdegeyn, annagoo si dhab ah u eegaya noloshaas quruxda badan ee uu Ilaahay inoo dhiibay mudada kooban.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'indhaha'. Akhriska koowaad ee Job, waxaan ka maqlaynaa nin dhex maray tijaabooyin waaweyn, nin marar badan is-weydiiyey sababta nolosha ay u noqotay mid mugdi ah. Laakiin ugu dambeyntii, Job wuxuu yiri: 'Ilaahow, waxaan ku maqlay dhegahayga, laakiin hadda isha ayaan kugu arkay.' Tani waa xudunta nolosha ruuxiga ah. Waa inaan ka gudubno waxa aan maqalnay oo aan u gudubno waxa aan aragno. Ben, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil indhihiisu ay mar walba eegayeen meel fog. Xusuusnow sida uu u jeclaa inuu 'airport spotting' sameeyo, isagoo eegaya diyaaradaha oo ka kacaya garoomada adduunka. Indhihiisu ma ahayn kuwo caadi ah; waxay ahaayeen indho raadinaya mustaqbal, indho arkayey quruxda farsamada iyo ballaadhka dunida. Wuxuu ahaa wiil indhihiisu ay u furnaayeen xaqiiqda ah in dunidu ay ka weyn tahay waxa aan maanta aragno.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ee la soo dhaafay ay ahaayeen kuwo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira waqtiyo habeenkii ah oo ay codadka gurigu aamusaan, oo ay xusuustaadu kusoo dhacdo dhoola-caddayntii Ben markii uu ku oran jiray 'Good morning, Dad.' Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan su'aalo culus: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkaan si tartiib ah u joojino oo aan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. Xusuusnow, xataa markii uu 15 sano jir ahaa, Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbi saafi ah oo rabay inuu u huro wax walba uu haysto si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Taasi waa dabeecadda wiilka aad koriseen, waana midda Ilaah uu ku farxo.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu ku farxay Ruuxa Quduuska ah, wuxuuna yiri: 'Aabbow, Sayidka jannada iyo dhulka, waan ku ammaanayaa, waayo waxyaalahan ayaad ka qarisay kuwa xigmadda leh, laakiin waxaad u muujisay kuwa carruurta ah.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiilkaas 'carruurta ah' ee Ciise ka hadlayo. Wuxuu lahaa xigmad ka fog buugaagta, xigmad ku dhex jirta daacadnimadiisa, jacaylkiisa, iyo awoodda uu u lahaa inuu dadka kale ka hormariyo naftiisa. Ciise wuxuu leeyahay: 'Farxad u leh indhaha arkay waxa aad aragteen.' Ben hadda wuxuu ku jiraa meel aanay jirin daal, meel aanay jirin baahida loo qabo in la sugo diyaarad ama la dhiso shirkad. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven', isagoo la jooga malaa'igta. Wuxuu idin leeyahay, iyadoo dhoola caddaynaya: 'Ha murugoonina.'

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha, wuxuuna idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
petitions: Rabbiyow, waxaan ku baryeynaa wiilkeenna Benjamin Vo iyo dhammaan kuwa dhintay, inuu nabadgelyo iyo iftiin ku dhex helo gacmahaaga.
Rabbiyow, waxaan ku baryeynaa dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inaan siiso rajo iyo kalsooni ay kugu aaminaan noloshooda.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho, maadaama aanan maanta si jidh ahaan ah kuu qaadan karin. Ii soo gal ruux ahaan, oo igu xidh naftaada weligaa.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin xafido, oo wejigiisa ha idiin ifiyo. Aamiin.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Markaasuu Job Rabbiga u jawaabay, wuxuuna ku yidhi, Waan ogahay inaad wax walba samayn karto, oo aanay jirin qorshe adiga kuu suurtowbi waayey. Waxaan ka hadlay waxyaalo waaweyn oo aanan fahmin, waxyaalo ila yaab badan oo aanan garan karin. Waxaan kugu maqlay dhegahayga, laakiin hadda isha ayaan kugu arkay. Sidaas darteed ayaan iska fogeeyey wixii aan idhi, oo waxaan ku toobad keenay boodh iyo dambas. Sidaas daraaddeed Rabbigu wuxuu barakeeyey maalmihii dambe ee Job in ka badan kuwii hore. Wuxuu lahaa afar iyo toban kun oo ido ah, lix kun oo geel ah, kun lammaane oo dibi ah, iyo kun dameer oo dheddig ah. Wuxuu kaloo lahaa toddoba wiil iyo saddex gabdhood, kii ugu horreeyey wuxuu u bixiyey Jemimah, kii labaadna Keziah, kii saddexaadna Kerenhappuch. Dalka oo dhan lagama helin dumar ka qurux badan gabdhihii Job; aabbahoodna wuxuu siiyey dhaxal ay walaalahood la wadaagaan. Intaas ka dib, Job wuxuu noolaa boqol iyo afartan sannadood; wuxuuna arkay carruurtiisii, iyo carruurtii carruurtiisii, iyo xataa carruurtii carruurtiisii carruurtooda. Markaasuu Job dhintay, isagoo oday ah oo cimrigiisu dhammaystiran yahay.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Rabbiyow, wejigaaga ha igu ifiyo. I bar xigmadda iyo aqoonta, waayo waxaan ku aaminay amarradaada. R. Rabbiyow, wejigaaga ha igu ifiyo. Waa ii wanaagsan tahay in lay dhibay, si aan u barto qaynuunnadaada. R. Rabbiyow, wejigaaga ha igu ifiyo. Rabbiyow, waan ogahay in xukummadaadu ay xaq yihiin, oo aad daacadnimadaada igu dhibtay. R. Rabbiyow, wejigaaga ha igu ifiyo. Sida xukummadaada ayay weli u taagan yihiin: wax walba way kuu adeegaan. R. Rabbiyow, wejigaaga ha igu ifiyo. Anigu waxaan ahay addoonkaaga; i sii garasho si aan u ogaado qaynuunnadaada. R. Rabbiyow, wejigaaga ha igu ifiyo. Muujinta ereyadaada ayaa iftiin bixisa, oo faham siisa kuwa fudud. R. Rabbiyow, wejigaaga ha igu ifiyo.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Markaasay toddoba iyo toddobaatankii xertiiba ku soo noqdeen farxad, waxayna ku yidhaahdeen, Sayidow, xataa jinniyadu way noo hoggaansamaan magacaaga aawadiis. Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Waxaan arkay Shayddaan oo ka soo dhacaya samada sidii hillaac. Bal eega, waxaan idin siiyey awood aad 'ku dul martaan abeesooyinka' iyo dabaqallooyinka iyo xoogga cadowga oo dhan, oo waxba idinma yeeli doonaan. Hase yeeshee, ha ku farxina in jinniyadu idin hoggaansameen, laakiin ku farxa in magacyadiinnu ay samada ku qoran yihiin. Wakhtigaas Ciise wuxuu ku farxay Ruuxa Quduuska ah, wuxuuna yidhi, Aabbow, Sayidka jannada iyo dhulka, waan ku ammaanayaa, waayo waxyaalahan ayaad ka qarisay kuwa xigmadda leh, laakiin waxaad u muujisay kuwa carruurta ah. Haa, Aabbow, taasi waxay ahayd doonistaada naxariista leh. Wax walba Aabbahay ayaa ii dhiibay. Qofna garan maayo Wiilka kan Aabbaha ah mooyee, qofna garan maayo Aabbaha kan Wiilka ah iyo kii uu Wiilku doonayo inuu u muujiyo mooyee. Markaasuu u soo jeestay xertii oo keligood ah, wuxuuna ku yidhi, Waxaa barakaysan indhaha arka waxaad aragtaan. Waxaan idin leeyahay, nebiyo iyo boqorro badan ayaa jeclaystay inay arkaan waxaad aragtaan, laakiin may arkin, inay maqlaan waxaad maqashaan, laakiin may maqal.

day: Saturday of the Twenty-sixth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.
